author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: 38 nonprofits with city funding also appear as behested payees or payors, or as lobbying clients.
paragraphs: The loop: the city funds a nonprofit; an official asks a donor to give to the same nonprofit; the nonprofit hires a lobbyist to work the department that funds it. Each step is lawful and disclosed. The table lists nonprofits where at least two steps are present, so readers can check the pattern with the rules beside it.

Appearing here is not improper. It is shown because behested payments to city-funded nonprofits were the mechanism in recent enforcement cases, and because the pattern is otherwise invisible across four datasets.
